description: Erection of a new front porch, a single storey rear extension and a single storey outbuilding to be used as a garage in the rear garden of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01, 02, 03 (Proposed Floor Plans), 03 (Proposed Plans/Elevations for outbuilding) and 05 [received 02/10/2019], and 04 [received 19/11/2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used incidental to the use of 3 Lionel Road North, TW8 9QZ, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
